verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe async job submission via run_job() returning a job ID immediately (docs-9, docs-23, docs-36), plus a production-grade Svix webhook system with signed requests, retries, and delivery dashboard (docs-10, docs-39, docs-28) for completion notifications, directly matching the non-blocking async pipeline story. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a status-polling endpoint/schema alongside webhooks, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of async+webhook reliability in production.
